messages:
olivia-support: customer uploaded a 20s screen recording of the console + network tab and says they got a 500 but we can't see a request id in the video. what minimal things should i ask for so eng can actually trace? :video_camera: :thinking:

maria-support: minimal bundle i ask for: 1) the HAR export (network -> export) for the time of the failure, 2) a screenshot of the Request/Response Headers for the failing call, 3) exact local timestamp (timezone), 4) if possible, the `Copy as cURL` for that request. if mobile, a 10-20s screen recording of the repro and any SDK logs. :mag:

sam-eng: add this: we need the raw response headers. ask them to paste full response headers (don't redact request ids). example curl to reproduce that they can paste (remind to redact the API key):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Then paste the verbatim curl output including `HTTP/1.1 500` and the following headers. look for `x-rw-req` or `x-request-id` in response headers.

olivia-support: if the customer is non-technical and can't export HAR, what's the fallback ask?

maria-support: fallback 1: ask them to open DevTools -> Network -> reproduce -> click the failing request -> right panel -> Headers. Screenshot that whole Headers pane. fallback 2: ask them to right-click the request -> "Copy" -> "Copy as cURL" and paste. fallback 3 (mobile): quick screen recording of the app reproducing the error, and a note of the exact clock time shown on the device.

jason-mobile: platform-specific: iOS SDK logs often include `sessionRef` or `requestRef` in the app log. suggest they search device logs for "sessionRef" or "reqRef". on Android, `adb logcat` will show the SDK debug lines if they have logging enabled. if they can't, get the screen recording timestamp and we can align with server logs.

alex-cs: reminder: always include steps to redact secrets. ask them to replace the API key with `<API_KEY>` in any pasted curl or HAR. warn about PII in HAR and give a quick checklist of fields to remove if needed. :shield:

sam-eng: internal triage checklist for the team once customer replies: 1) match their timestamp to our request logs, 2) search for `x-rw-req` / `x-request-id` around that time, 3) if request id present, attach payload and response for replay, 4) if no request id, check for proxy stripping and client-side proxies, 5) if still missing generate a debug token and ask customer to run our debug assistant to produce a debug bundle.

olivia-support: i'll send a single concise message with the curl snippet, the HAR export link, and a short checklist for non-tech users. also add a sentence about redacting keys.

debug-bot: incident-lookup helper: run `tools/find_request --time 2026-03-10T15:42:00Z --path /v1/generate --near <user-timestamp>` to search logs quickly, include `--show-headers` to surface `x-rw-req` if present.

olivia-support: perfect — sending now. will add a note: "if you're able to paste the full response headers please do not redact the request id — only redact your API key.""
